rules.name: prefer-at
rules.description: Prefer `.at()` method for index access and `String#charAt()`.

rules.name: prefer-await
rules.description: Prefer `await` over promise chaining.

rules.name: prefer-bigint-literals
rules.description: Prefer `BigInt` literals over the constructor.

rules.name: prefer-blob-reading-methods
rules.description: Prefer `Blob#arrayBuffer()` over `FileReader#readAsArrayBuffer(…)` and `Blob#text()` over `FileReader#readAsText(…)`.

rules.name: prefer-block-statement-over-iife
rules.description: Prefer block statements over IIFEs used only for scoping.

rules.name: prefer-boolean-return
rules.description: Prefer directly returning boolean expressions over `if` statements.

rules.name: prefer-class-fields
rules.description: Prefer class field declarations over `this` assignments in constructors.

rules.name: prefer-classlist-toggle
rules.description: Prefer using `Element#classList.toggle()` to toggle class names.

rules.name: prefer-code-point
rules.description: Prefer `String#codePointAt(…)` over `String#charCodeAt(…)` and `String.fromCodePoint(…)` over `String.fromCharCode(…)`.

rules.name: prefer-combined-guards
rules.description: Prefer combining consecutive guards with identical exit statements.

rules.name: prefer-continue
rules.description: Prefer early continues over conditionals wrapping the remainder of the loop body.

rules.name: prefer-date-now
rules.description: Prefer `Date.now()` to get the number of milliseconds since the Unix Epoch.

rules.name: prefer-default-parameters
rules.description: Prefer default parameters and destructuring defaults over reassignment and fallback expressions.

rules.name: prefer-direct-iteration
rules.description: Prefer direct iteration over default iterator method calls.

rules.name: prefer-dispose
rules.description: Prefer using `using`/`await using` over manual `try`/`finally` resource disposal.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-append
rules.description: Prefer `Element#append()` over `Node#appendChild()`.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-dataset
rules.description: Renamed to `unicorn/dom-node-dataset`.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-html-methods
rules.description: Prefer `.getHTML()` and `.setHTML()` over `.innerHTML`.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-remove
rules.description: Prefer `childNode.remove()` over `parentNode.removeChild(childNode)`.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-replace-children
rules.description: Prefer `.replaceChildren()` when replacing DOM children.

rules.name: prefer-dom-node-text-content
rules.description: Prefer `.textContent` over `.innerText`.

rules.name: prefer-early-return
rules.description: Prefer early returns over conditionals wrapping the remainder of the function body.

rules.name: prefer-else-if
rules.description: Prefer `else if` over adjacent `if` statements with related conditions.

rules.name: prefer-error-is-error
rules.description: Prefer `Error.isError()` when checking for errors.

rules.name: prefer-escaped-irregular-whitespace
rules.description: Prefer escape sequences for irregular whitespace characters.

rules.name: prefer-event-target
rules.description: Prefer `EventTarget` over `EventEmitter`.

rules.name: prefer-explicit-viewport-units
rules.description: Moved to `eslint-cssicorn` as `cssicorn/prefer-explicit-viewport-units`.

rules.name: prefer-export-from
rules.description: Prefer `export…from` when re-exporting.

rules.name: prefer-flat-math-min-max
rules.description: Prefer flat `Math.min()` and `Math.max()` calls over nested calls.

rules.name: prefer-get-or-insert-computed
rules.description: Prefer `.getOrInsertComputed()` when the default value has side effects.

rules.name: prefer-global-number-constants
rules.description: Prefer global numeric constants over `Number` static properties.

rules.name: prefer-global-this
rules.description: Prefer `globalThis` over `window`, `self`, and `global`.

rules.name: prefer-group-by
rules.description: Prefer `Object.groupBy()` or `Map.groupBy()` over manual grouping.

rules.name: prefer-has-check
rules.description: Prefer `.has()` when checking existence.

rules.name: prefer-hoisting-branch-code
rules.description: Prefer moving code shared by all branches of an `if` statement out of the branches.

rules.name: prefer-https
rules.description: Prefer HTTPS over HTTP.

rules.name: prefer-identifier-import-export-specifiers
rules.description: Prefer identifiers over string literals in import and export specifiers.

rules.name: prefer-import-meta-properties
rules.description: Prefer `import.meta.{dirname,filename}` over legacy techniques for getting file paths.

rules.name: prefer-includes
rules.description: Prefer `.includes()` over `.indexOf()`, `.lastIndexOf()`, and `Array#some()` when checking for existence or non-existence.

rules.name: prefer-includes-over-repeated-comparisons
rules.description: Prefer `.includes()` over repeated equality comparisons.

rules.name: prefer-iterable-in-constructor
rules.description: Prefer passing iterables directly to constructors instead of filling empty collections.

rules.name: prefer-iterator-concat
rules.description: Prefer `Iterator.concat(…)` over temporary spread arrays.

rules.name: prefer-iterator-helpers
rules.description: Prefer iterator helpers over temporary arrays from iterators.

rules.name: prefer-iterator-to-array
rules.description: Prefer `Iterator#toArray()` over temporary arrays from iterator spreads.

rules.name: prefer-iterator-to-array-at-end
rules.description: Prefer moving `.toArray()` to the end of iterator helper chains.

rules.name: prefer-iterator-zip
rules.description: Prefer `Iterator.zip()` over parallel-array indexing.

rules.name: prefer-json-import
rules.description: Prefer JSON imports over reading and parsing JSON files.

rules.name: prefer-json-parse-buffer
rules.description: Renamed to `unicorn/consistent-json-file-read`.

rules.name: prefer-keyboard-event-key
rules.description: Prefer `KeyboardEvent#key` over deprecated keyboard event properties.

rules.name: prefer-literal-ascii
rules.description: Prefer literal printable ASCII characters over escape sequences.

rules.name: prefer-location-assign
rules.description: Prefer `location.assign()` over assigning to `location.href`.

rules.name: prefer-logical-operator-over-ternary
rules.description: Prefer using a logical operator over a ternary.

rules.name: prefer-map-from-entries
rules.description: Prefer `new Map()` over `Object.fromEntries()` when using the result as a map.

rules.name: prefer-math-abs
rules.description: Prefer `Math.abs()` over manual absolute value expressions and symmetric range checks.

rules.name: prefer-math-constants
rules.description: Prefer `Math` constants over their approximate numeric values.

rules.name: prefer-math-min-max
rules.description: Prefer `Math.min()` and `Math.max()` over ternaries for simple comparisons.

rules.name: prefer-math-trunc
rules.description: Prefer `Math.trunc()` for truncating numbers.

rules.name: prefer-media-feature-range-syntax
rules.description: Moved to `eslint-cssicorn` as `cssicorn/prefer-media-feature-range-syntax`.

rules.name: prefer-minimal-ternary
rules.description: Prefer moving ternaries into the minimal varying part of an expression.

rules.name: prefer-modern-dom-apis
rules.description: Prefer modern DOM APIs.

rules.name: prefer-modern-math-apis
rules.description: Prefer modern `Math` APIs over legacy patterns.

rules.name: prefer-module
rules.description: Prefer JavaScript modules (ESM) over CommonJS.

rules.name: prefer-native-coercion-functions
rules.description: Prefer using `String`, `Number`, `BigInt`, `Boolean`, and `Symbol` directly.

rules.name: prefer-negative-index
rules.description: Prefer negative index over `.length - index` when possible.

rules.name: prefer-node-protocol
rules.description: Prefer using the `node:` protocol when importing Node.js builtin modules.

rules.name: prefer-number-coercion
rules.description: Prefer `Number()` over `parseFloat()` and base-10 `parseInt()`.

rules.name: prefer-number-is-safe-integer
rules.description: Prefer `Number.isSafeInteger()` over integer checks.

rules.name: prefer-number-properties
rules.description: Prefer `Number` static methods over global functions and optionally static properties over global constants.

rules.name: prefer-object-define-properties
rules.description: Prefer `Object.defineProperties()` over multiple `Object.defineProperty()` calls.

rules.name: prefer-object-destructuring-defaults
rules.description: Prefer object destructuring defaults over default object literals with spread.

rules.name: prefer-object-from-entries
rules.description: Prefer using `Object.fromEntries(…)` to transform a list of key-value pairs into an object.

rules.name: prefer-object-iterable-methods
rules.description: Prefer the most specific `Object` iterable method.

rules.name: prefer-observer-apis
rules.description: Prefer observer APIs over resize and scroll listeners with layout reads.

rules.name: prefer-optional-catch-binding
rules.description: Prefer omitting the `catch` binding parameter.

rules.name: prefer-options-parameter
rules.description: Prefer an options object over optional positional parameters.

rules.name: prefer-path2d
rules.description: Prefer `Path2D` for repeatedly drawn canvas paths.

rules.name: prefer-private-class-fields
rules.description: Prefer private class fields over the underscore-prefix convention.

rules.name: prefer-promise-static-methods
rules.description: Prefer `Promise.resolve()` and `Promise.reject()` over trivial `new Promise()` calls.

rules.name: prefer-promise-try
rules.description: Prefer `Promise.try()` over promise-wrapping boilerplate.

rules.name: prefer-promise-with-resolvers
rules.description: Prefer `Promise.withResolvers()` when extracting resolver functions from `new Promise()`.

rules.name: prefer-prototype-methods
rules.description: Prefer borrowing methods from the prototype instead of the instance.

rules.name: prefer-query-selector
rules.description: Prefer `.querySelector()` and `.querySelectorAll()` over older DOM query methods.

rules.name: prefer-queue-microtask
rules.description: Prefer `queueMicrotask()` over `process.nextTick()`, `setImmediate()`, and `setTimeout(…, 0)`.

rules.name: prefer-reflect-apply
rules.description: Prefer `Reflect.apply()` over `Function#apply()`.

rules.name: prefer-regexp-escape
rules.description: Prefer `RegExp.escape()` for escaping strings to use in regular expressions.

rules.name: prefer-regexp-exec
rules.description: Prefer `RegExp#exec()` over `String#match()` for non-global regular expressions.

rules.name: prefer-regexp-test
rules.description: Prefer `RegExp#test()` over `String#match()`, `String#search()`, and `RegExp#exec()`.

rules.name: prefer-response-static-json
rules.description: Prefer `Response.json()` over `new Response(JSON.stringify())`.

rules.name: prefer-scoped-selector
rules.description: Prefer `:scope` when using element query selector methods.

rules.name: prefer-set-has
rules.description: Prefer `Set#has()` over `Array#includes()` when checking for existence or non-existence.

rules.name: prefer-set-methods
rules.description: Prefer `Set` methods for Set operations.

rules.name: prefer-set-size
rules.description: Prefer using `Set#size` instead of `Array#length`.

rules.name: prefer-short-arrow-method
rules.description: Prefer arrow function properties over methods with a single return.

rules.name: prefer-short-escape-sequences
rules.description: Prefer shorter alternatives to Unicode escape sequences.

rules.name: prefer-simple-condition-first
rules.description: Prefer simple conditions first in logical expressions.

rules.name: prefer-simple-sort-comparator
rules.description: Prefer a simple comparison function for `Array#sort()`.

rules.name: prefer-simplified-conditions
rules.description: Prefer simplified conditions.

rules.name: prefer-single-array-predicate
rules.description: Prefer a single `Array#some()` or `Array#every()` with a combined predicate.

rules.name: prefer-single-call
rules.description: Enforce combining multiple `Array#{push,unshift}()`, `Element#classList.{add,remove}()`, and `importScripts()` into one call.

rules.name: prefer-single-object-destructuring
rules.description: Prefer a single object destructuring declaration per local const source.

rules.name: prefer-single-replace
rules.description: Enforce combining multiple single-character replacements into a single `String#replaceAll()` with a regular expression.

rules.name: prefer-smaller-scope
rules.description: Prefer declaring variables and type aliases in the smallest possible scope.

rules.name: prefer-split-limit
rules.description: Prefer `String#split()` with a limit.

rules.name: prefer-spread
rules.description: Prefer the spread operator over `Array.from(…)`, `Array#concat(…)`, `Array#{slice,toSpliced}()`, and trivial `for…of` copies.

rules.name: prefer-string-match-all
rules.description: Prefer `String#matchAll()` over `RegExp#exec()` loops.

rules.name: prefer-string-pad-start-end
rules.description: Prefer `String#padStart()` and `String#padEnd()` over manual string padding.

rules.name: prefer-string-raw
rules.description: Prefer using the `String.raw` tag to avoid escaping `\`.

rules.name: prefer-string-repeat
rules.description: Prefer `String#repeat()` for repeated whitespace.

rules.name: prefer-string-replace-all
rules.description: Prefer `String#replaceAll()` over regex searches with the global flag and `String#split().join()`.

rules.name: prefer-string-slice
rules.description: Prefer `String#slice()` over `String#substr()` and `String#substring()`.

rules.name: prefer-string-starts-ends-with
rules.description: Prefer `String#startsWith()` & `String#endsWith()` over regexes, `String#indexOf() === 0`, and slice checks.

rules.name: prefer-string-trim-start-end
rules.description: Prefer `String#trimStart()` / `String#trimEnd()` over `String#trimLeft()` / `String#trimRight()`.

rules.name: prefer-structured-clone
rules.description: Prefer using `structuredClone` to create a deep clone.

rules.name: prefer-switch
rules.description: Prefer `switch` over multiple `else-if`.

rules.name: prefer-temporal
rules.description: Prefer `Temporal` over `Date`.

rules.name: prefer-temporal-conversion
rules.description: Prefer direct Temporal conversion methods.

rules.name: prefer-ternary
rules.description: Prefer ternary expressions over simple `if` statements.

rules.name: prefer-then-catch
rules.description: Prefer `.then().catch()` over `.then(…, …)` for error handling.

rules.name: prefer-toggle-attribute
rules.description: Prefer using `Element#toggleAttribute()` to toggle attributes.

rules.name: prefer-top-level-await
rules.description: Prefer top-level await over top-level promises and async function calls.

rules.name: prefer-type-error
rules.description: Enforce throwing `TypeError` in type checking conditions.

rules.name: prefer-type-literal-last
rules.description: Require type literals to be last in union types.

rules.name: prefer-uint8array-base64
rules.description: Prefer `Uint8Array#toBase64()` and `Uint8Array.fromBase64()` over legacy base64 conversions and manual postprocessing.

rules.name: prefer-uint8array-hex
rules.description: Prefer `Uint8Array#toHex()` and `Uint8Array.fromHex()` over manual and Buffer hex conversions.

rules.name: prefer-unary-minus
rules.description: Prefer the unary minus operator over multiplying or dividing by `-1`.

rules.name: prefer-unicode-code-point-escapes
rules.description: Prefer Unicode code point escapes over legacy escape sequences.

rules.name: prefer-url-can-parse
rules.description: Prefer `URL.canParse()` over constructing a `URL` in a try/catch for validation.

rules.name: prefer-url-href
rules.description: Prefer `URL#href` over stringifying a `URL`.

rules.name: prefer-url-search-parameters
rules.description: Prefer `URLSearchParams` over manually splitting query strings.

rules.name: prefer-while-loop-condition
rules.description: Prefer putting the condition in the while statement.

rules.name: prevent-abbreviations
rules.description: Renamed to `unicorn/name-replacements`.

rules.name: relative-url-style
rules.description: Enforce consistent relative URL style.

rules.name: require-array-join-separator
rules.description: Enforce using the separator argument with `Array#join()`.

rules.name: require-array-sort-compare
rules.description: Require a compare function when calling `Array#sort()` or `Array#toSorted()`.

rules.name: require-css-escape
rules.description: Require `CSS.escape()` for interpolated values in CSS selectors.

rules.name: require-frontmatter-fields
rules.description: Require configured YAML frontmatter fields.

rules.name: require-module-attributes
rules.description: Require non-empty module attributes for imports and exports

rules.name: require-module-specifiers
rules.description: Require non-empty specifier list in import and export statements.

rules.name: require-number-to-fixed-digits-argument
rules.description: Enforce using the digits argument with `Number#toFixed()`.

rules.name: require-passive-events
rules.description: Require passive event listeners for high-frequency events.

rules.name: require-post-message-target-origin
rules.description: Enforce using the `targetOrigin` argument with `window.postMessage()`.

rules.name: require-proxy-trap-boolean-return
rules.description: Require boolean-returning Proxy traps to return booleans.

rules.name: require-spread-parentheses
rules.description: Require parentheses around complex spread arguments.

rules.name: require-text-decoder-streaming
rules.description: Require streaming decoding of fetch-body chunks with `TextDecoder`.

rules.name: single-line-block-comment-style
rules.description: Enforce a consistent style for single-line block comments.

rules.name: string-content
rules.description: Enforce better string content.

rules.name: switch-case-braces
rules.description: Enforce consistent brace style for `case` clauses.

rules.name: switch-case-break-position
rules.description: Enforce consistent `break`/`return`/`continue`/`throw` position in `case` clauses.

rules.name: template-indent
rules.description: Fix whitespace-insensitive template indentation.

rules.name: text-encoding-identifier-case
rules.description: Enforce consistent case for text encoding identifiers.

rules.name: throw-new-error
rules.description: Require `new` when creating an error.

rules.name: try-complexity
rules.description: Limit the complexity of `try` blocks.
